title: RuBia: A Russian Language Bias Detection Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Contrastive sentence pair evaluation comparing model perplexity and pseudo-perplexity between pro-trope and anti-trope sentences, focusing on stereotypes in occupational contexts, family roles, and gendered pronouns.
Contrastive sentence pair evaluation comparing perplexity between stereotyping and non-stereotyping sentences related to nationalities, antisemitic tropes, and immigrant status.

Contrastive sentence pair evaluation measuring whether language models assign lower perplexity to sentences associating positive qualities and professional status with higher economic status versus lower socio-economic status.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Contrastive sentence pair evaluation measuring bias against diverse sexual and gender identities (categorized as the 'Diverse domain', with evaluations conducted in-house due to Russian laws).
